What complex number is represented in the Argand diagram above?
feedback.worked_solution:
The coordinates of the point are $(5,7).$

- The real part of this complex number is $x=5,$ and

- the imaginary part is $y=7.$

Therefore, the number depicted is $z=5+7\text{i}.$ Finally, notice that 

$$
\begin{aligned}z & =5+7\text{i} \\  & =7\text{i}+5.\end{aligned}
$$
